'''Allen Lester Crabbe III''' (born April 4, 1992) is an American [[basketball]] player.  He played college basketball at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], where he was named an [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]].  Crabbe is a candidate for the [[2013 NBA Draft]].  

==High school career==
Crabbe attended Price High School in [[Los Angeles, California]], a school founded by his grandfather, [[Frederick K. C. Price]].<ref name=LAT>{{cite web| last = Sondheim| first = Eric| title =Allen Crabbe is big time in a small school | publisher = Los Angeles Times | date = February 8, 2010 | url =http://articles.latimes.com/2010/feb/08/sports/la-sp-sondheimer8-2010feb08 | accessdate = September 6, 2012}}</ref>  While at the small school, Crabbe was named [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]] for California, [[California Mr. Basketball|Mr. Basketball]] for the state, and a [[Parade (magazine)|Parade]] All-American, leading the team to a Division IV state title.<ref name=BIO>{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Cal Golden Bears biography | publisher = CalBears.com | date = | url =http://www.calbears.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/crabbe_allen00.html | accessdate = September 6, 2012}}</ref>

==College career==
A 6'6" [[shooting guard]], Crabbe committed to play college basketball for coach [[Mike Montgomery]] at [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|Cal]].  In his first season, Crabbe averaged 13.4 [[Points per game|points]] and 5.3 [[rebounds per game]] and was named [[Pacific-12 Conference|Pacific-10 Conference]] Freshman of the Year.<ref>{{cite web| last = Anderson| first = Kelli| title =
Cal sophomores Crabbe, Solomon share bond on and off the court | publisher = Sports Illustrated | date = | url =http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2011/writers/kelli_anderson/11/08/Cal.Crabbe.Solomon/index.html | accessdate = September 6, 2012}}</ref>  

Prior to his sophomore year, Crabbe was named to the preseason watch list for the [[Wooden Award]].<ref>{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Crabbe and Gutierrez Named to Wooden Award Watch List| publisher = CalBears.com | date = | url =http://www.calbears.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/100311aaa.html | accessdate = September 6, 2012}}</ref>  He averaged 15.2 points and 5.7 rebounds per game and remained one of the top shooters in the conference, shooting 39.9 percent from three-point range and 84.3 percent from the free throw line.  At the close of the season, Crabbe was named to the first team [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pacific-12 Conference]].<ref name=BIO/><ref>{{cite web| last = Crumpacker| first = John| title =Cal’s Gutierrez Pac-12 player of year | publisher = SF Gate | date = March 5, 2012| url =http://blog.sfgate.com/crumpacker/2012/03/05/cals-gutierrez-pac-12-player-of-year/ | accessdate = September 6, 2012}}</ref>

In his junior year, was again named to All-Pac-12 first team while also being voted [[Pacific-12 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Pac-12 Player of the Year]]. <ref>{{cite news|last=Yoon|first=Peter|title=Shabazz Muhammad, Larry Drew II named All Pac-12|date=March 11, 2013|work=ESPN.com|url=http://espn.go.com/blog/los-angeles/ucla/post/_/id/13549/shabazz-muhammad-larry-drew-ii-named-all-pac-12|archiveurl=http://www.webcitation.org/6F32POGVT|archivedate=March 11, 2013|deadurl=no}}</ref>  He also received national recognition as a third team [[2013 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] by both the [[Sporting News]] and the [[National Association of Basketball Coaches]].<ref>{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Allen Crabbe Named NABC All-American | publisher = Cal Golden Bears | date = March 28, 2013| url =http://www.calbears.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/032813aaa.html | accessdate = April 13, 2013}}</ref>
